title: Kconfig: LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD missing depends on LICHEN_COAP_KEYS (link failure in permitted config)
description: Kconfig:325-329: after the LICHEN_SCHNORR48->LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR dep fix, config SERVER=y + LINK_SCHNORR=y + SLOT_COORD=y + LICHEN_COAP_KEYS=n is permitted but fails to link: coap_slot_coord.c process_claim references lichen_key_store_get (defined only under CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS). Worse, LICHEN_COAP_KEYS depends on LICHEN_SLIP_TRANSPORT (Kconfig:217, bead a2a2), so SLOT_COORD is reachable in configs where the key store is unsatisfiable. Fix: add depends on LICHEN_COAP_KEYS (NOT select — a select could re-expose the a2a2 failure when SLIP is off; the Kconfig:99 select precedent works only because SLIP happens to be on). Verify with a SERVER+LINK_SCHNORR+SLOT_COORD+KEYS=y build and a KEYS=n Kconfig rejection.
close_reason: Kconfig:324-331: added depends on LICHEN_COAP_KEYS to LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD (depends, NOT select - KEYS depends on LICHEN_SLIP_TRANSPORT per bd a2a2, a select would re-expose that link failure when SLIP is off). Commit 5ffd34b7fe. EVIDENCE: (1) Module-aware chain build (ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=lichen, qemu_x86/atom, pristine): with LICHEN=y COAP=y LINK=y SLIP=y KEYS=y SLOT_COORD=y, .config resolved SLOT_COORD=y KEYS=y LINK_SCHNORR=y and build.ninja queued coap_slot_coord.c (3 refs). (2) Module-aware gcc type-check of coap_slot_coord.c with the resolved autoconf.h, A/B vs HEAD blob with identical flags: diagnostic sets byte-identical modulo +4 line shift from this wave's insertions (11 pre-existing: missing app-level CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_PLAINTEXT_MAX define, switch-enum LICHEN_TIME_SOURCE_NONE at 1075, 3x struct coap_core_metadata .attributes drift) - ZERO diagnostics in my hunks. Full link on the local 4.1.0 workspace is blocked by that pre-existing drift in untouched files (coap_client.c send_mutex is v3.7.0 API; coap_status.c BUILD_ASSERTs) - same blocker the 2hte close documented; CI pins v3.7.0 where it does not exist. (3) KEYS=n rejection: pristine build with SLOT_COORD=y + KEYS=n -> Kconfig warning 'LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD ... was assigned the value y but got the value n. Check these unsatisfied dependencies: LICHEN_COAP_KEYS (=n)', .config has SLOT_COORD=n, coap_slot_coord.c absent from build.ninja. Twister coap_config build phase 176/176 green (run phase environmentally blocked: qemu connects to hard-coded /tmp/slip.sock listener, upstream cmake/emu/qemu.cmake; /tmp off-limits per session rules - suite compiles only coap_config.c anyway).
